scenarios.fresh_cold: Empty product cache root on a clean runner. Proves cold miss/save or proxy export without pre-existing remote state.
scenarios.same_runner_rerun: Repeat on the same machine or same job after clearing the tool's local output/cache directory. Proves behavior is not hidden by leftover build output.
scenarios.fresh_runner_rerun: Repeat the same ref on a fresh runner without purging the product cache root. Proves remote restore/import works for a customer-like warm CI run.
scenarios.fresh_rerun_after_purge: Purge the product cache root and repeat the fresh path. Proves the cold path is reproducible and catches one-off runner or setup flukes.
scenarios.same_ref_rerun: Run the same source ref and same workflow graph again without purge. Proves rolling steady-state behavior and avoids treating first reseed as parity.
scenarios.same_alias_two_writers: Publish two immutable run refs that promote the same alias. Proves stale promotion is rejected while immutable run refs remain readable.
scenarios.archive_save_restore_delete_retire_clean: Archive entry save, immediate restore, delete/retire, bounded cleanup, and post-retirement restore denial.
scenarios.cas_save_restore_retire_cleanup: CAS entry save, immediate restore, retire, cleanup, and post-retirement restore denial.
scenarios.oci_save_restore_retire_cleanup: OCI registry entry save, immediate import, retire, cleanup, and post-retirement import denial.
scenarios.cleanup_interruption_recovery: Interrupted cleanup resumes idempotently without deleting live entry links or current tag heads.
scenarios.quota_concurrent_saves: Concurrent over-quota saves retire the correct candidates, protect current heads, and enqueue bounded cleanup.
scenarios.many_small_blobs: v2 stage/commit/publish under many-small-blob pressure stays non-blocking and returns structured results.
scenarios.large_oci_graph: v2 stage/commit/publish under a large OCI graph stays non-blocking and keeps restore/check latency bounded.
scenarios.duplicate_concurrent_saves: Duplicate concurrent saves converge without corrupt publish or hidden lock contention.
scenarios.pending_upload_resume: A pending upload can resume or reconcile into a named terminal state.
scenarios.manifest_only_zero_blob_cas: Zero-blob CAS publish is accepted without unnecessary storage verification on the request path.
scenarios.publish_terminalization_race: Publish after terminalization returns a structured conflict or retryable state, not a 500.
scenarios.namespace_over_quota: Namespace over-quota enforcement runs after publish and retires entries without blocking the save hot path.
scenarios.workspace_over_quota: Workspace over-quota enforcement runs after publish and retires entries without blocking the save hot path.
scenarios.storage_transient_failure: Storage transient failures produce bounded structured errors and diagnosable session state.
scenarios.default_branch_writes_default: Default branch writes only the default scope and can restore the intended default cache.
scenarios.trusted_branch_reads_branch_default_writ: Trusted non-default branches read branch/default and write only the branch scope.
scenarios.pr_restore_reads_base_default: Pull requests restore base/default by default without write authority.
scenarios.pr_save_writes_pr_only: Explicit PR save writes PR-only scope and does not poison base/default caches.
scenarios.fork_pr_restore_only: Untrusted fork pull requests remain restore-only even when workflow metadata is hostile.
scenarios.split_token_restore_save: Restore and save tokens keep separate roles, and Rails enforces the write scope.
scenarios.cache_registry_status_endpoint: cache-registry readiness uses the canonical /_boringcache/status contract.
scenarios.run_proxy_status_endpoint: run --proxy readiness uses the canonical /_boringcache/status contract.
scenarios.adapter_command_status_endpoint: Adapter commands use the same readiness model and do not rely on fixed sleeps or log scraping.
scenarios.shutdown_publish_settlement: Proxy shutdown publish settles through a bounded, observable path.
scenarios.signup_email_confirm: A new user signs up, confirms email, and reaches a usable workspace.
scenarios.oauth_magic_link: OAuth and magic-link auth paths produce usable sessions with throttling and audit evidence.
scenarios.passkey_2fa_recent_reauth: Passkey, 2FA, and recent reauthentication protect sensitive actions.
scenarios.cli_connect_token_create_rotate_revoke: CLI connect and token create, rotate, revoke paths work with role-specific tokens.
scenarios.free_team_custom_limits: Free, Team, and Custom plan limits match the public package contract.
scenarios.checkout_portal_cancel: Checkout, billing portal, cancellation, and subscription lifecycle paths work.
scenarios.namespace_workspace_usage_reporting: Namespace and workspace usage reporting agrees with enforced storage budgets.
scenarios.hard_cap_async_eviction: Hard caps enqueue async eviction and explain retirement reason without corrupting cache state.
scenarios.downgrade_replication_byoc_blockers: Downgrades block or explain replication and BYOC states that cannot fit the target plan.
scenarios.cache_session_summary_customer_safe: Customer-safe session summaries are present and linkable from run evidence.
scenarios.hit_miss_reason: Hit, miss, partial hit, expected reseed, and failure reasons are legible without reading raw logs.
scenarios.backend_storage_tool_evidence: Diagnostics separate CLI/action, backend API, storage, and adapter/tool evidence.
scenarios.datadog_slo_dashboard: Launch SLO monitor and dashboard evidence is attached for the deployed revision.
scenarios.signup_to_first_cache_to_diagnostics: A new user can sign up, connect, run first cache, and see proof/debug output.
